meta.title: Who else bid and their bid status stay hidden from a vendor (known defect BUG-63, the bid-count angle)
gaps: The setup provides one submitted bid from each of two QA vendors, but cannot express vendor B submitting a second bid as a revision.
The available read-back fields do not expose individual bid status, so bid-status hiding is not checked separately.
There is no dedicated operation for opening the live event; read_event is used as the closest available operation.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor reads the event.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “participants” has exactly 1 entries.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “participants” has exactly 1 entries.
